inventory.notes: One ThinkPad, no person, no other objects, nothing touching the picture edge. Screen compared line by line with notepat-native.png: wordmark notepat.com with no trademark sign; sliders fx 100%, echo 0%, pitch +0c, crush 0%, vol 100%, drive 0%, wobble 0% in that order, fx full and vol half filled; tabs sine tri saw square pno harp whist sample; chips 'no usb' and 'wave sine'; key letters c v d s e f w g r a q b and h t i y j k u l o m p n; c lit red, g lit blue; waveform band; five nested rectangles on pink. Kept deviation: the three small chips at the top right are drawn as blank colour blocks where the frame reads usb off, udp and fps24; nothing wrong is written there.

orientation.notes: Single clamshell from the user's side: trackpad, keyboard, hinge, then the screen rising behind and facing the camera. No lid back visible.
